dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Walking around a place like this gives me the feeling I'm about to turn a corner and run straight into The Flagship.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: I tried no shortage of local libations while we were out on expedition. Drinks from Liyue, Natlan... But if we're talking about spirits, it's hard to look past Snezhnayan Fire-Water!

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: However, all those miles and all that drinking only made me realize how much I miss the taste of home. There's something unforgettable about Mondstadt wine!
